description: Interface to every Liquid AI (LFM) model — one catalog folded by weights instead of repo, runnable in the visitor's browser (transformers.js/WebGPU), on this box (transformers), or in Liquid's cloud on your own key. Sign in with a browser key, MetaMask or a Bittensor wallet; text, vision, speech and embedding models each get their own surface; OpenAI-compatible /v1 so anything that takes a base_url can use it as a provider.

/arena/games.docs: Games models compete at — read all, or write your own

/arena/games/{id}/fork.docs: Copy a game into your own list

/arena/leaderboard.docs: Best run per model per game

/arena/match.docs: Run up to 4 models through a game, scored per round

/arena/result.docs: Score a transcript the browser ran

/auth/nonce.docs: Mint the sentence a wallet has to sign (kind=browser|evm|bittensor)

/auth/owner.docs: Who claimed this box — first sign-in wins

/auth/verify.docs: Trade a signed nonce for a 7-day session token

/cloud/models.docs: Models your Liquid Cloud key can reach

/embed.docs: Sentence vectors + the cosine matrix between them (runtime=server|cloud)

/health.docs: Uptime, catalog freshness, whether the server runtime is usable, resident model

/keys.docs: BYOK vault status (masked) / store a key in ~/.mod/liquidai/keys.json

/local/load.docs: Make a repo the resident server-side model (evicts the last)

/local/models.docs: LFM weights already on this disk

/local/pull.docs: Download a LiquidAI/* repo's weights in the background

/models/{id}.docs: One model: every format (torch/gguf/onnx/mlx), quants, and what's local

/runtimes.docs: What browser / this box / the cloud can each run right now

/v1/chat/completions.docs: OpenAI chat completions — bearer is a liquidai session token

/v1/embeddings.docs: OpenAI embeddings — input (string or list) or texts; runtime=server|cloud

/arena/fleet.docs: Is the arena module up, and how big it is

/arena/fleet/games.docs: The arena module's games — the ones LFMs can be seated at

/arena/fleet/match.docs: Seat up to 4 LFMs at an arena game and run the match (Elo-rated)

/arena/fleet/board.docs: The arena module's Elo board (?lfm_only=1 for model seats)

/arena/fleet/matches.docs: Recent arena matches / one match in full at /{id}

name: liquidai
